newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen heading higher at start.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen heading higher at start.

text.p: U.S. stocks are expected to move higher with bonds at the start of trading Friday, with investors bracing for next week's meeting of the Fed's Federal Open Market Committee.
High techs will get a boost from a favorable 3Com Corp fiscal third quarter earnings report released after the close of trade yesterday. 3Com shares were up 1-3/4 at 35-3/8 ahead of the opening bell.
U.S. Treasuries were mostly higher, with the long bond up 4/32 to yield 6.95 percent.
